cells.value: as per approved schedule vide IHQ MoD (N) / DSR letter WP / 0642 dated 06 Aug 14. Following observed:-
Information. Check the following information provided by the AIS:-
(v) Location of position-fixing antenna on the ship (aft of bow and port or starboard of centreline).
(i) Ship's position with accuracy indication and integrity status.
(v) Navigational status (NUC, at anchor etc through manual input).
Information Update Rates for Autonomous Mode – Check validity of different information as follows:-
(a) Static Information – Every 6 min and on request.
(b) Dynamic Information – Dependant on speed and course alteration according to the under mentioned table.
(c) Voyage Related Information – Every 6 min, when data has been amended and on request.
(d) Safety-related messages on as required basis.
Security. Check security mechanism to detect disabling and to prevent unauthorised alteration of input or transmitted data.
Permissible Initialisation Period. Check for system to be operational within 02 minutes of switching on.

Interfaces. Check interfaces with analog and digital navigational systems and aids like GPS, Gyro, Log, Navigational Radar(s), ECDIS, Integrated Bridge System (IBS) and CTD / CAIO System Combat Management System (CMS) catering for shipboard systems of different origins / manufactures and vintages.
Check AIS for “Receive Only” mode information when own transmission is switched off.
